recordText: From the 1590s, meaning fashionably elegant. It's the same French word that had come in earlier as *gentle*, borrowed again with the French pronunciation kept on purpose. The OED notes that since the 1840s it has mostly been used in mockery.
gossipText: Gentle's returning sister, back with an accent and a better coat. Everyone calls her lovely. Nobody means it.
testimony: He came over from France in the 1650s, the same as some of us. Back then he was a guardian spirit. Very respectable. Very Latin.
